facts: Seven UK/Ireland-based spring raiders entered pre-export quarantine and were scheduled to fly to Melbourne on 27 September.
Small Fry was expected to seek Melbourne Cup qualification via the Geelong Cup.
Point Of Law was sold to Ciaron Maher clients and was to transfer to Maher on arrival.

governance.ratings: No numeric rating is stated in this source; none is inferred.
governance.status: Travel and connection evidence only. Scheduled travel is not treated as confirmed arrival.
